changelog:
🧭 前后端职责重构：后端全权负责数据新鲜度（额度/订阅/超额状态定时刷新收紧到 5 分钟，模型缓存等低频维护保持 30 分钟），管理网页改为纯读取渲染——删除账号卡「刷新账号」、全局/批量「刷新模型」、批量「刷新」及详情弹窗「加载模型/刷新路由缓存/从 AWS 拉取超额」全部手动刷新按钮，并同步删除对应的 5 个后端手动刷新端点与泄漏凭证的 /full 死端点。
✨ 详情弹窗：三段保存合并为底部统一「保存」；打开弹窗即拉取单账号最新数据（新增 GET /admin/api/accounts/{id}）并渲染缓存模型（带倍率/描述，不再实时打上游）。
📈 超额状态并入定时刷新：直接复用同一次 getUsageLimits 响应提取 Overages 开关/上限/累计，零额外上游调用；未定型存量账号由后台自动探测并按能力自动开启。实时 TPM 由后端 60 秒滚动窗口计算（totalTPM），前端不再自行差分估算。
🛡️ 刷新防误封：定时刷新遇 401/403 先刷 token 重试，连续 3 次失败才封禁禁用，避免收紧刷新间隔放大瞬时抖动误伤健康账号。
🧹 清理：删除无引用的遗留管理页 index-legacy.html 及孤儿 i18n 词条。
🧭 Frontend/backend split: the backend now owns ALL data freshness (account quota/subscription/overage refresh tightened to 5min; models cache and maintenance stay at 30min) and the admin UI is strictly GET+render — every manual refresh trigger (per-account refresh, global/batch model refresh, batch refresh, detail modal's load-models / refresh-route-cache / pull-overage) is removed along with the 5 backend manual-refresh endpoints and the credential-leaking dead /full endpoint.
✨ Detail modal: unified footer Save; opening fetches fresh single-account data (new GET /admin/api/accounts/{id}) and renders cached models (with multiplier/description, no live upstream pull).
📈 Overage folded into the periodic refresh reusing the SAME getUsageLimits response (zero extra upstream calls); undetermined legacy accounts get probed and auto-enabled by capability. Realtime TPM is now backend-computed (totalTPM, trailing-60s ring) instead of client-side delta sampling.
🛡️ Ban tolerance: refresh 401/403 first retries after a token refresh and only bans after 3 consecutive failures, so the tighter interval cannot amplify transient blips into false bans.
🧹 Removed the unreferenced legacy admin page (index-legacy.html) and orphaned i18n keys.
